record_type_quote: A genetic association study was performed to investigate the association between XbaI SNP in ESR1 and the predisposition for, or progression of, AIS in Caucasian patients.

targets.authors: Inoue, M., Minami, S., Nakata, Y., Kitahara, H., Otsuka, Y., Isobe, K., Takaso, M., Tokunaga, M., Nishikawa, S., Maruta, T., Moriya, H.
targets.title: Association between estrogen receptor gene polymorphisms and curve severity of idiopathic scoliosis
targets.evidence_quote: It has been suggested that XbaI single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) (A/G rs934099) in estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1) may be associated with curve severity in Japanese AIS patients [1] and with both curve severity and predisposition for AIS in Chinese patients [2].
targets.outcome_quote: No association between ESR1 XbaI polymorphism and AIS was found in the Caucasian population. None of the previously reported associations with curve severity, progression or operation rate could be confirmed.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion rejects the previously reported associations as a set. The earlier negative replication is cited as context, not re-tested as the designated claim.
